# How Statefold compares

These pages compare Statefold with other ways to run coding agents in the cloud. Each one says when the other product is the better choice. Competitor details were checked on their official sites on November 19, 2026.

## From the harness makers

Each company’s own cloud for its own agent. The simplest choice if you use one agent.

## Other cloud workspaces

Products that also run coding agents in cloud machines, each with its own take on agents, billing and teams.

## Agents

A coding agent of its own, built around the model you pick, with its own cloud sandboxes.

## Your next thread, shipped while you’re away

$3of machine time to start. Bring your own subscriptions and keys.

results.title: Statefold – Event-sourced state, replay and time travel for LangGraph agents - Talking Shop - LangChain Forum
results.content:
For LangGraph applications, Statefold can provide:

Statefold is intended to sit underneath LangGraph rather than replace it. LangGraph continues to manage graph orchestration, nodes, edges and execution flow, while Statefold acts as a durable, portable and replayable state layer.

Basic installation:

`pip install "statefold[langgraph]"`

The project is licensed under Apache 2.0 and is currently in active development.

I would especially appreciate feedback from LangGraph users on:

Contributions, issues and integration feedback are welcome.

### Related topics [...] # Statefold – Event-sourced state, replay and time travel for LangGraph agents

Hi everyone,

I’m sharing Statefold, an open-source, framework-agnostic state and observability platform for AI agents.

GitHub: GitHub - ioteverythin/statefold: Framework-agnostic, event-sourced state platform for AI agents (LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, MCP) · GitHub

LangGraph provides strong orchestration and checkpointing capabilities, but agent state can still become difficult to inspect, replay, branch or move across frameworks as applications grow more complex.

Statefold takes an event-sourced approach: agent state is not stored as a mutable blob. Instead, it is derived by folding over an append-only event log containing messages, state changes, tool calls, LLM calls, traces and memory events.
